designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1972 when Laurence and Lorna Marshall donated their land on North Pack Monadnock to the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service; New Hampshire's first national wildlife refuge.

authority.citation: Land donation to the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Wapack National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Wapack National Wildlife Refuge, established in 1972 through a donation from Laurence and Lorna Marshall, was New Hampshire's first refuge.
